description: This file provides error handling functions for the libnl library, including error message retrieval, error printing, and system error to libnl error code conversion.

methods.name: nl_geterror
methods.description: Returns an error message string corresponding to an error code.

methods.name: nl_perror
methods.description: Prints a libnl error message with an optional prefix.

methods.name: nl_syserr2nlerr
methods.description: Converts system error codes to libnl error codes.
